title: RAW: arbitrary independent run-length allographs tested against invariant external source contexts
summary: A distinct complete writer replaces geometric elongation by paid arbitrary finite categorical e/i run distributions per exact page, collapsed source word and slot. A fixed line scaffold is supplied. Test single-run words against collapsed external-neighbor forms, preserving observed histograms and position strata. No meanings or native collapse selected.

design.mechanism: Source words over22working drawings have no adjacent e/e or i/i; replace each e/i by a positive run drawn independently from a fixed finite rational distribution per page/whole sourceword/slot, with default length1. Preserve other units, source order and word gaps. Reader collapses e/i runs, exactly recovering symbolic source. A supplied fixed line scaffold makes physical group positions invariant.
design.unit: Exactly-one-e/i-run sourceword occurrence with strict original1233target and strict same-line neighbors, all original source indices preserved; two readers separately.
design.contrast: Condition on exact page, full collapsed word and line-position third, and on the observed run-length histogram. Independent categorical draws are exchangeable. Neighbor forms are themselves collapsed before features, so shuffling another target cannot change a covariate.
design.prediction: After source/position conditioning, arbitrary independent length choices cannot preferentially associate with invariant external-neighbor form features. A fixed kernel association statistic is compared to within-stratum permutations, capacity checked before scoring.
design.scope: Old1233strict Pcache joined to915cached source metadata;179old selectors; ZL3b/IT2a separately; no images/reserves/new corpus. No meanings or assertion that collapsed forms are actual synonyms.

decision_note.unknown: Whether nongeometric independently chosen run variants are conditionally context-neutral, after1328rejected only the geometric marginal law. No such exact test found in bounded1329/1170/1323/787/854/1254review.

outcome_changes.rejected: Do not use this independent categorical rule as an account of the fixed panel; context-dependent rendering, semantic contrast, serial/layout effects and selection remain different explanations.
outcome_changes.not_rejected: No exclusion, no equal-meaning collapse or accepted writer. Do not start a decoder.
outcome_changes.capacity: Stop before null simulations. Do not lower gates or expand cohort.

decision_note.smallest_test: One fixed combined left/right collapsed-neighbor bigram-kernel statistic on single-run forms, conditional histograms and position thirds; witnessed statistic mobility plus leaf capacity before1999draws.
decision_note.budget_policy: Includes preparation, implementation, independent validation and publication; stop expansion at limit.

assumptions: 22working-unit segmentation and strict whole-group boundaries are premises.
Collapsed word is a source bookkeeping hypothesis, not an inferred meaning.
Fixed line scaffold and selection/uncertainty masks must not depend on length choices after conditioning.
Arbitrary categorical distributions are constant within declared cells, not peroccurrence.
Run choices are independent across occurrences/slots; page/word habits allowed.
Reader outcomes are alternative transcriptions, not independent replications.
No deterministic full-neighbor lookup or memorized lexical assignments.
